name: a voxel field ripples under an orbiting sphere
looks: A tilted field of small blocks sits lit like a studio product shot; a glossy sphere with a thin orbit ring sits at the centre, sending ripples out through the blocks that lift and shift colour from the ground tone through to the accent at the peak.
build: voxel-ripple-3d: an InstancedMesh of boxes with heights and colours set per frame from a ripple function centred on the sphere's position, the sphere itself held in a slow orbit rather than falling.
sound: A low drone under the orbit, a soft ripple shimmer radiating outward.
prompt: Light a tilted field of small 3D blocks like a studio product shot, with a glossy sphere orbiting slowly at the centre sending ripples out through the field that lift the blocks and shift their colour toward the accent at the peak. Use it as a materials-and-craft beat between type-driven scenes.
